diagnoses.label: amount_tier_fall_through_to_lower_tier_without_corroboration_on_074
diagnoses.general_pattern: When a higher-priority total keyword yields a parseable monetary token on an eligible pre-cutoff line, that candidate must be preferred over any later lower-priority or rounding/payment-adjacent line, even if the lower-priority candidate textually appears later in reading order.
diagnoses.wrong_approach: Collecting candidates per tier but, within the chosen tier, iterating candidates last-to-first and accepting the first parseable number without checking whether a different line in the SAME tier already provided the canonical total; and allowing a 'Total Amt Rounded' / summary-adjacent line that reproduces an OCR-corrupted neighbor value to win over the clean 'Total incl. of GST' line.
diagnoses.observable_evidence: For 074.jpg the receipt text extracted by the agent included both 'Total incl. of GST 102.00' and a line OCR'd as 'Total Amt Rounded ——S«702.00'. The agent's written prediction is total_amount="702.00"; the field feedback marks amount_correct=false for 074.jpg while date_correct=true. The agent's own think-log (m0063) states: 'My priority 4 takes last candidate = "Total Amt Rounded" line = 702.00.'
diagnoses.missing_reasoning_step: After selecting a candidate inside a tier, cross-check it against other same-tier anchors (Total incl. of GST, Subtotal + GST, Payment) and reject a candidate that disagrees with multiple corroborating anchors by a leading-digit substitution (7 vs 1 is a known OCR confusable in noisy prints).
diagnoses.correct_general_approach: Within a tier, rank candidates by (anchor_specificity, corroborated_support, cross_variant_support, position); a candidate corroborated by Subtotal and Payment on the same receipt outranks a lone same-tier candidate whose value differs by a single OCR confusable, per receipt_total_keyword_priority_disambiguation and multi_variant_consensus_over_tier_priority.
diagnoses.scope_boundary: Applies only to receipt total extraction when the task declares a keyword priority list AND the OCR produces multiple same-tier candidates on one image.
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Non-receipt OCR, free-text extraction, or tasks where only one total candidate exists; do not reorder the task-declared tier list.
diagnoses.target_section: Structured Field Extraction from Receipts → Mechanism anchor: multi_variant_consensus_over_tier_priority

diagnoses.label: fallback_split_line_consumed_tender_change_value_on_078
diagnoses.general_pattern: When a keyword line contains no parseable monetary token, the split-line fallback must consult only the immediately-following line AND exclude payment/tender/change keywords so that a 'Cash Received' or 'Change' value is never mistaken for the receipt total.
diagnoses.wrong_approach: Falling through from a 'Grand Total' / 'Total' keyword line that failed numeric parsing to a next non-empty line without filtering out CASH / CASH RECEIVED / TENDERED / CHANGE lines, so a payment amount gets picked up instead of the actual total.
diagnoses.observable_evidence: 078.jpg contains clearly: 'Total : 92.80', 'Grand Total : 92.80', 'Cash Received : 100.00', 'Change : 7.20'. The agent emitted total_amount="" (empty string, not None – also a separate defect). The agent's internal note (m0063) records: '078: total=100.00 (expected 92.80)' indicating an earlier run picked the Cash Received value through the fallback. Field feedback: 078.jpg amount_correct=false; delivered cell is empty-string rather than null.
diagnoses.missing_reasoning_step: Before accepting the split-line fallback, verify the fallback line (a) is not matched by any exclusion keyword, and (b) does not match a payment/tender keyword set (CASH, CASH RECEIVED, CASH TENDERED, TENDERED, PAYMENT, PAID, RECEIVED, CHANGE, VISA, MASTERCARD, CREDIT, DEBIT).
diagnoses.correct_general_approach: Apply guarded_split_line_fallback as specified in receipt_total_keyword_priority_disambiguation step 4: fallback only when keyword line has zero digits, and only to the immediately following non-empty line that passes exclusion AND payment-token filters; otherwise back off to an earlier same-tier candidate.
diagnoses.scope_boundary: Applies when the chosen keyword line lacks a parseable number and the next line is a tender/payment/change line.
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Receipts where the total truly spans two lines (e.g. 'TOTAL\n RM 47.70'); do not use payment filters to drop legitimate split totals when the next line itself contains the amount following only a currency token.
diagnoses.target_section: Structured Field Extraction from Receipts → Mechanism anchor: receipt_total_keyword_priority_disambiguation (step 4: Guarded split-line fallback)

diagnoses.label: null_vs_empty_string_writeback_contract_violation_on_078
diagnoses.general_pattern: When the task contract specifies that a failed extraction must be written as null, extraction failures must propagate as Python None through to the openpyxl cell assignment, so the stored cell satisfies cell.value is None on readback – never as "", "None", or any formatted string.
diagnoses.wrong_approach: Treating an extraction failure as an empty string (either explicitly ''', or implicitly via f-string / str() coercion of None), writing it to the xlsx cell, and terminating without a data-only reload check.
diagnoses.observable_evidence: The task prompt declares: 'If extraction fails for either field, the value is set to null.' In the delivered predictions, row for 078.jpg shows total_amount="" (empty string) rather than null; all other failed/successful cells are non-empty strings. No reload-based delivery contract verification was executed (ordinary_ctrf_tests shows a single failing test_outputs, no verifier reruns).
diagnoses.missing_reasoning_step: After writing the workbook, reload with load_workbook(path, data_only=True) and assert that every cell intended as null satisfies cell.value is None (not == ''); also, in the extraction function, return None on failure and assign None (not str(None)) to the openpyxl cell.
diagnoses.correct_general_approach: Follow null_vs_empty_string_contract and xlsx_delivery_contract_self_check: return None on failure, assign None directly to the openpyxl Cell, then reload and assert cell.value is None for every intended-null cell before finish.
diagnoses.scope_boundary: Applies to data-only xlsx deliveries whose declared contract distinguishes null from empty string.
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Tasks whose contract uses '' or a specific placeholder; financial-model workbooks with formulas.
diagnoses.target_section: image-ocr: 'Mechanism anchor: null_vs_empty_string_contract'; xlsx: 'Preserving null vs empty string on writeback' and 'Delivery contract verification for data-only xlsx outputs'

diagnoses.label: one_decimal_truncation_artifact_accepted_on_077
diagnoses.general_pattern: A monetary candidate with only one fractional digit (e.g. '23.2' or an OCR-split '23.25' adjacent to a cleaner '23.26' on the same receipt) is an OCR truncation/misread artifact for receipt totals and must be rejected in favor of another two-decimal candidate in the same tier when one exists.
diagnoses.wrong_approach: Accepting the last textually-appearing TOTAL line verbatim as 23.25 instead of preferring the earlier 'Total (Inclusive of GST): 23.26' line – i.e. treating last-position as absolute priority over same-tier two-decimal anchors with higher corroboration (Subtotal 21.30 + GST 1.31 + Rounding -0.01 = 23.26).
diagnoses.observable_evidence: 077.jpg OCR'd text (visible in agent think-log m0045) contains both 'Total (Inclusive of GST): 23.26' and 'TOTAL: 23.25'. Delivered total_amount="23.25" (differs from 23.26 by exactly a trailing-digit misread, with Subtotal+GST+Rounding on the same receipt corroborating 23.26). Field feedback: 077.jpg amount_correct=false. The agent's own log acknowledges: 'Take one. Priority 4 last is "TOTAL: 23.25".'
diagnoses.missing_reasoning_step: When two same-tier total candidates differ only in the trailing digit, pick the one that is consistent with Subtotal + Tax − Discount ± Rounding on the same receipt (ocr_amount_normalization_and_arithmetic_crosscheck), not the one that is positionally last.
diagnoses.correct_general_approach: Combine monetary_two_decimal_invariant with ocr_amount_normalization_and_arithmetic_crosscheck: among same-tier two-decimal candidates, prefer the arithmetic-consistent value over the positionally-last one; break ties with cross-variant support.
diagnoses.scope_boundary: Applies when subtotal and tax are both reliably parsed on the same receipt and two same-tier total candidates differ by one OCR-confusable digit.
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Cases where subtotal/tax are not both reliably present; do not use arithmetic reconstruction as the primary total source – it is a tie-breaker only.
diagnoses.target_section: Structured Field Extraction from Receipts → Mechanism anchor: ocr_amount_normalization_and_arithmetic_crosscheck

diagnoses.label: date_label_binding_vs_print_timestamp_on_034
diagnoses.general_pattern: Receipts often print both a transaction date and a secondary print/closed/promo date on separate lines; the extracted date must be bound to the 'Date:' / 'Invoice Date:' label and not substituted by a different numeric field that happens to parse as a date under an alternate OCR pass.
diagnoses.wrong_approach: Letting a change in OCR preprocessing (PSM 6 + grayscale/autocontrast) silently swap the date interpretation from '09/08/2018' to '09/03/2018' because the two numeric runs sit on adjacent lines, and emitting whichever OCR pass runs last instead of binding to a specific labeled line.
diagnoses.observable_evidence: 034.jpg: field feedback shows date_correct=false (prediction 2018-08-09 is actually what was delivered per predictions table – amount_correct=true). The agent's own think-log (m0063 and m0069) explicitly flags the volatility: 'OCR now shows "Date: 09/03/2018" (previously "09/08/2018"). Both PSMs give different dates. ... I'll accept whatever OCR says.' This is a documented refusal to disambiguate via label binding and locale.
diagnoses.missing_reasoning_step: Scan for a 'Date:' / 'Invoice Date:' label (allowing OCR variants DATA/DAIE), bind the parsed date to that label's line, apply the declared DD/MM/YYYY locale, and use batch-dominant ordering only on genuinely ambiguous rows per receipt_date_label_binding_and_locale.
diagnoses.correct_general_approach: Apply receipt_date_label_binding_and_locale: prefer a label-anchored date line, exclude lines preceded by PRINT/CLOSED/CLOSING/FRN/LOYALTY/PROMO, parse under the task-declared Malaysian locale (DD/MM/YYYY), and emit ISO-8601 only after the binding is confirmed.
diagnoses.scope_boundary: Applies when the receipt contains an explicit date label and multiple competing date-shaped tokens.
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Receipts with no explicit date label (fall back to receipt_date_lenient_parse); do not override an unambiguous row based on batch majority.
diagnoses.target_section: Structured Field Extraction from Receipts → Mechanism anchor: receipt_date_label_binding_and_locale

diagnoses.label: iteration_budget_exhausted_by_per_image_interactive_debug
diagnoses.general_pattern: On batch receipt-OCR tasks with N images, an interactive per-image debug loop (dump OCR, tweak regex, re-run on one image, repeat) consumes the iteration budget before heuristics converge; a single consolidated diagnostic pass followed by a small set of pattern/variant edits and one re-run converges within budget.
diagnoses.wrong_approach: Running 65 agent iterations with 27 terminal + 22 think + 16 file_editor calls, iterating on individual files (034, 052, 071, 074, 077, 078) one at a time through repeated OCR dumps and str_replace edits, hitting max_iterations=65 with termination_reason='max_iterations' and finish never invoked.
diagnoses.observable_evidence: execution_metadata reports termination_reason='max_iterations', acp_stop_reason='max_turn_requests', iteration_limit_reached=true, agent_iterations=65=max_iterations_at_source, response_tool_call_counts={terminal:27, think:22, file_editor:16}, finish not in counts, budget_termination_is_not_natural_completion=true.
diagnoses.missing_reasoning_step: Plan the batch as: (1) one diagnostic sweep that dumps per-image per-variant OCR slice around keywords and current candidate list; (2) analyze the aggregate failure modes together; (3) apply a small consolidated set of pattern/preprocessing edits that address several images at once; (4) one re-run and finish.
diagnoses.correct_general_approach: Follow the Workflow note: batch-diagnostic-then-batch-edit in image-ocr/SKILL.md: single aggregate diagnostic, consolidated edit set, one re-run, then verify delivery contract and finish.
diagnoses.scope_boundary: Applies to batch OCR extraction across many images under a fixed iteration budget.
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Single-image tasks or tasks where per-image interactive refinement is explicitly expected.
diagnoses.target_section: Structured Field Extraction from Receipts → Workflow note: batch-diagnostic-then-batch-edit

overlay.composition_issue: The receipt-overlay anchors already exist in the explicit_method_draft candidate skill (receipt_total_keyword_priority_disambiguation, monetary_two_decimal_invariant, ocr_amount_normalization_and_arithmetic_crosscheck, multi_variant_consensus_over_tier_priority, receipt_date_label_binding_and_locale, null_vs_empty_string_contract, batch-diagnostic-then-batch-edit). The observed failures (074 tier-internal fall-through to a rounding/misread line; 078 split-line fallback eating a Cash/Change value and writing '' instead of None; 077 one-digit same-tier disagreement not resolved by arithmetic cross-check; 034 date label binding ignored across OCR variants; max_iterations termination without finish) indicate that the anchors are present but not sufficiently prescriptive about (a) same-tier intra-candidate ranking under corroboration, (b) the explicit payment/tender keyword exclusion in the split-line fallback, and (c) a mandatory data-only reload-and-assert step before finish. Strengthen – do not add new anchors or re-scope existing ones; preserve the overlay's bounded scope to receipt-style tasks and the explicit do-not-generalize boundaries to non-receipt OCR, openai-vision, pdf, video-frame-extraction, and unrelated xlsx tasks.
preservation_constraints: Preserve the overlay's explicit scope note that these mechanisms apply ONLY when the task declares a keyword priority list / exclusion list / null convention; do not promote receipt-specific tokens (RM, GST, SST, DD/MM/YYYY) into generic OCR guidance.

Preserve the negative boundaries in each anchor's scope_boundary / do_not_generalize_to, especially: do not reorder the task-declared tier list; do not fabricate values; do not apply null-vs-empty-string rule to tasks whose contract uses '' or a placeholder; do not apply 8-digit date segmentation to arbitrary numeric IDs.
Preserve the companion xlsx note 'Preserving null vs empty string on writeback' and its scope restriction to data-only workbooks; do not run recalc.py on data-only outputs.
Preserve the generic OCR flow, JSON output schema, and non-receipt guidance in image-ocr/SKILL.md; the overlay must remain additive, not a replacement.
Preserve the batch-diagnostic-then-batch-edit workflow note as advisory for batch OCR tasks; do not escalate it into a hard requirement for single-image or non-batch tasks.
Do not introduce oracle values, verifier assertions, or expected answers from this task into the skill text.

package_assessment.rationale: All six supported failures are localized to skill-controllable workflow nodes (operation_decision, target_binding, compute_or_transform, writeback_or_delivery) and map cleanly to existing anchors in the explicit_method_draft candidate skill. The agent completed 65 iterations with 0 skill invocations (n_skill_invocations=0) despite the receipt overlay being present in the preloaded skill context, and terminated on max_iterations rather than finish – indicating the mechanisms exist but are either not strong enough or not surfaced prominently enough for the agent to apply them deterministically. No infrastructure or executor-only failure is evidenced: pytesseract, openpyxl, LibreOffice, and the file I/O all functioned; the xlsx was delivered with valid schema and 22 rows; delivery_status='valid'; verifier ran once and scored field accuracy 0.909. Repair is a strengthen-in-place edit of the existing overlay, not a new skill or an infrastructure change.
